title: As Coolie Releases, A Look At How Rajinikanth's Last 5 Films Did At The Box Office | Tamil Cinema News - News18
text: Superstar Rajinikanth is celebrating his 50-year-long journey in the film industry with the release of his action thriller film Coolie . Helmed by Lokesh Kanagaraj, the film has finally hit the theatres today and is receiving positive reviews from fans and critics alike. It also features Nagarjuna Akkineni, Shruti Haasan, Pooja Hegde and a special cameo from Aamir Khan. Regarding the Pre-Release sales, the film has reportedly garnered a whopping Rs 46 crore in advance bookings, selling more than 17 lakh tickets across all languages in India. While the Tamil version leads in sales, the Hindi version has also performed well, selling approximately 53,173 tickets. As Coolie releases, let’s take a look at the box office performance of Thalaiva’s last five releases: Petta Released in 2019, Petta was reportedly made in a budget of around Rs 160 crore, but as per sacnilk.com, it collected only Rs 134.6 crore at the domestic market and turned out to be a loss. The film also featured Vijay Sethupathi and Nawazuddin Siddiqui in the leads. Darbar After the failure of Petta, Rajinikanth came up with Darbar in 2020, made on a huge budget of Rs 200 crore and with high expectations. However, the film failed at the box office, collecting only Rs 149.6 crore in India. Annaatthe The two big failures were followed by another flop, Annaatthe, which was released in 2021. Reportedly made on a budget of Rs 180 crore, the film only earned Rs 107 crore at the domestic box office. Jailer After consecutive failures, Jailer, released in 2023, provided much-needed relief to Rajinikanth. The picture, which cost Rs 200 crores to make, generated Rs 345 crores in net revenue at the Indian box office. Helmed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the makers have already announced the film’s sequel. Vettaiyan Despite a star-studded cast including Rajinikanth, Amitabh Bachchan and Rana Daggubati, the actor’s last film, Vettaiyan, also turned out to be a flop at the box office. Reportedly, it was made on a budget of Rs 250-280 crores and earned only Rs 148.32 crores net. Now, all eyes are on Coolie. Let’s see whether the Lokesh Kanagaraj directorial will give the superstar a sense of relief or not.
